An '''Imperial Sanction Card''' allowed individuals to carry personal weapons on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. They were available for thirty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a security check at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="GC">''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''</ref>
